query: Consider the following context: The ability to endure extreme corrosion in challenging environments is reduced in stainless steel. This can be addressed by appropriate surface modification techniques to redefine the surface with the required properties. In that context, which method can be used for improved corrosion resistance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: If stainless steel is plasma-nitrided under controlled low-temperature, nitrogen-rich conditions, then its corrosion resistance will significantly improve compared to untreated stainless steel due to the creation of a nitrogen-enriched passivation layer on the surface.
generation.material_initial_state: Stainless steel with insufficient corrosion performance in aggressive media
generation.intervention: Low-temperature plasma nitriding treatment in a nitrogen-rich atmosphere
generation.conditions: Exposure to corrosive environments (e.g., high salinity or acidic conditions)
generation.mechanism: Nitrogen diffuses into the steel surface, altering surface chemistry and improving passivation, thereby reducing dissolution and pitting
generation.predicted_outcome: Reduced corrosion rates and enhanced surface hardness compared to untreated stainless steel
generation.baseline: Untreated stainless steel performance in the same corrosive environment
generation.boundary: Effectiveness may vary with processing temperature and time; extremely severe chemical environments or high process temperatures may diminish benefits
generation.uncertainty: Long-term durability of the nitrided layer under repeated thermal or mechanical cycling is not fully established

falsification_experiment.design: Expose identical stainless steel samples, with and without plasma nitriding, to accelerated corrosion testing in the same harsh environment for a fixed duration
measurements: Corrosion rate via mass loss or corrosion current density
Depth profiles of nitrogen diffusion using microstructural analysis (e.g., SEM/EDS)
Changes in surface hardness and microhardness
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If plasma-nitrided samples do not exhibit measurably lower corrosion rates or higher microhardness relative to untreated samples, the hypothesis is falsified.
